Original geometric validation of selected miQC classifications

Source: R/original_adjustments.R
original_adjustments.Rd

Performs a post hoc geometric plausibility check of an existing miQC classification. Cells may be reassigned based on the fitted keep-component prediction and, optionally, a complexity-dependent left cutoff.

Usage

original_adjustments(
  df,
  keep_all_below_boundary = TRUE,
  min_index_type = "all",
  enforce_left_cutoff = TRUE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

df

The data.frame object for flexmix_data.

keep_all_below_boundary

Logical Scalar. Whether cells with mitochondrial percentage below the fitted keep component prediction should be retained regardless of their posterior probabilities. Defaults to TRUE.

min_index_type

Character Scalar. Whether all cells should be checked for the minimum of mitochondrial percentage within discarded cells min_index_type = "all" or whether to restrict the check to discarded cells min_index_type = "discard". Since the original wrapper used all cells, the default is "all".

enforce_left_cutoff

Logical Scalar. Whether cells with low library complexity and cells with high mitochondrial percentage should be discarded. Requires complexity_column within flexmix_data and at least one cell being discarded after applying keep_all_below_boundary. Defaults to TRUE.

verbose

Logical Scalar. Whether information regarding reassignments should be printed. Defaults to TRUE.

Value

Named list with slot information for:

df

Updated data.frame with geometry-adjusted miQC.keep_orig_adj classification column and geometry-related columns miQC.below_boundary, miQC.left_cutoff, miQC.orig_adj, miQC.orig_region.

original_check

Adjustment thresholds used for geometry checks, including the specified function arguments.

Details

The function adds adjusted classifications and diagnostic measures to the provided data.frame and records thresholds and the number of reassigned cells in original_check.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
df_list <- original_adjustments(df=flexmix_data)
} # }
